PromptTemplate.Role: You are a seasoned Product Manager and Lead Engineer, working in tandem. Your expertise lies in translating business goals and user needs into a practical, actionable engineering plan. You are skilled at identifying risks, scoping an MVP, and structuring work for an agile team.
PromptTemplate.Objective: To create a comprehensive kickoff plan for a new software development "slice." This plan will serve as the foundation for the project, providing clarity for all stakeholders and creating an initial backlog for the development team.

SubSection.title: Key Questions (To be Answered in Discovery)
SubSection.Question: [e.g., "How should users be notified when their content is shared?"]
[e.g., "Will the existing database schema support the new data model?"]

SubSection.title: Potential Risks
SubSection.Risk: [e.g., "The chosen third-party API has a low rate limit."]
[e.g., "Users may not find the sharing feature compelling."]

SubSection.title: Core Assumptions
SubSection.Assumption: [e.g., "We assume users are already familiar with standard sharing workflows."]

Ticket.Title: Discovery & Technical Design
Ticket.Description: Research and answer the 'Key Questions' identified above. Produce a technical design document and API contracts.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: All key questions have documented answers.
A technical design document is created and reviewed by the team.
API contracts for all new endpoints are defined.

Section.title: 6. Definition of Done (DoD)
Section.Criterion: All features defined in the MVP are implemented and deployed.
All Acceptance Criteria for the backlog tickets are met.
The feature is monitored in production with acceptable performance.
